_help: Tier 3, weak-coherent BB84 at the single-photon level (attenuated pulsed laser near 850 nm, silicon single-photon detectors, FPGA timing). The model's source is ideal (assumption A-01): a mean photon number mu << 1 is represented as extra loss of -10 log10(mu) dB (here mu = 0.2, about 7 dB), which is right for detection and error rates and says nothing about photon-number-splitting attacks; decoy states are needed for that. Dark-count probability is per detection window (about 300 counts/s in a 3 ns window).
